source_note: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题
english_source_note: A Limit Problem for Lattice Points and Floor Sums
callout_id: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题#3
statement_en: For $$S_n:=\sum_{i\leq n}\sum_{j\leq 2n}\frac{2}{n^2}\left\lfloor\frac{2i+j}{n}\right\rfloor,$$ can this sum, up to an error of order $o(1)$, be regarded as a Riemann sum?
callout_body: $$S_n:=\sum_{i\leq n}\sum_{j\leq 2n}\frac{2}{n^2}\left\lfloor\frac{2i+j}{n}\right\rfloor$$这个和，在$o(1)$的精度范围内，是否可以看成是一个黎曼和?
